name: Súantrade

attributes.attribute: a legendary Irish harper whose music could break hearts
held great power over listeners in Irish tradition

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Súantrade is an Irish hero and a legendary harper. Tradition holds that the music he played was so sad that those who heard it died of broken hearts. The sorrow in his playing was absolute and could not be endured. In folk memory he stands among the great musicians of Irish legend, a figure whose art held real power over its listeners. The tale is an exaggeration, but it shows the high value that old Ireland placed on the harper. Music was not mere entertainment in that world. It could move the heart, stir grief, and touch the very edge of death. Súantrade embodies that belief.
